State-bounded evidence

No invented answer

MECHANISMS
Three controls make the evidence repeatable
01
Versioned contract
The VM and adapter agree before the model runs.
Request, response, unavailable state, and evidence records are schema-bound.
02
Correlated provenance
One request ID joins guest, Service, model, and validation evidence.
The evidence record stores a request hash, not the raw note or a credential.
03
Fail-closed authority
A result can explain; it cannot act.
The model has no tools, action list, or promotion authority. The human operator decides.
